```artifact
## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** System Backup and Report Generation

**Target System:** Virtual Medical Assistant (VMA)

**Test Suite Description:** This suite verifies the functionality of the system's nightly backup and report generation features.

**Test Suite Scope:**
- Back-up of the system (Database and Code)
- Report generation for doctors, patients, and specialties

**Test Suite Preconditions:**
- System is running and connected to the remote site.
- User accounts for doctors, chemists, labs, and patients are created.

**Test Suite Postconditions:**
- Back-up files are successfully transferred to the remote site.
- Reports are generated and stored in the system.

**Test Suite Data:**
- Doctor credentials
- Patient credentials
- Specialty information

**Test Cases:**

| Test Case ID | Test Case Title | Requirement ID | Test Case Type | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected Results |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | Verify Back-up of Database | Req-13 | Positive | System is running | None | System performs nightly back-up of database | Back-up files are transferred to remote site |
| TC-002 | Verify Back-up of Code | Req-13 | Positive | System is running | None | System performs nightly back-up of code | Back-up files are transferred to remote site |
| TC-003 | Verify Password Change | VIRTUA-13-1 | Positive | User account exists | New password | User changes password | Password is updated successfully |
| TC-004 | Verify Patient Registration | VIRTUA-13-2 | Positive | None | User-id, password | Patient registers with user-id and password | Account is created successfully |
| TC-005 | Generate Doctor Appointment Report | VIRTUA-13-3.1 | Positive | Report date range specified | Date range | System generates doctor appointment report | Report contains appointments for the specified date range |
| TC-006 | Generate Consultation Report | VIRTUA-13-3.2 | Positive | Report date range specified | Date range | System generates consultation report | Report contains consultation data for the specified date range |
| TC-007 | Generate Revenue Report | VIRTUA-13-3.3 | Positive | Report date range specified | Date range | System generates revenue report | Report contains revenue data for the specified date range |
| TC-008 | Verify Incorrect Password | VIRTUA-13-1 | Negative | User account exists | Incorrect password | User attempts to log in with incorrect password | Error message is displayed |
| TC-009 | Verify Missing User-id | VIRTUA-13-2 | Negative | None | Missing user-id | Patient attempts to register without user-id | Error message is displayed |

```
